effect_size: absolute paired mean, paired SD, standardized dz, fraction of seed differences below zero; family-specific
equal_time_reproducibility: wall time horizon varies with load; exact state resumption at same interaction count, not guaranteed identical temporal stopping horizon
primary: structured minus direct mean regret per interaction; mean four families within complete seed, at T20000 only
secondary: all mean value errors and decision losses at shared held-out contexts
equal-time realized regret/interactions/reward and final readouts
secondary_multiplicity: exploratory pointwise intervals; no simultaneous claims
seed_unit: whole seed, all four families paired
time_cap_rule: if cap reached before time budget, mark censored, no equal-time superiority claim; do not silently shorten or extend
